About the developer

Shelter Aid is developed by Abhimanyu Kaushik, an independent builder focused on using software for real-world impact—especially for people who are underserved and need clear, practical tools when stress is high and time is short.

Shelter Aid helps people quickly find nearby shelters when they need support most.

Built with a nonprofit mission, Shelter Aid makes shelter information easier to access by bringing together publicly available data from trusted public websites and community resources.

What you can do with Shelter Aid

• Discover shelters near your current location
• Search by ZIP code or area
• View shelter details in one place
• Explore options on an interactive map
• Quickly access contact information where available

Our mission

Shelter Aid is designed to improve access to essential shelter information for individuals, families, volunteers, and nonprofit teams.

Data transparency

All shelter listings and related details in this app are aggregated from publicly available online sources. Availability, services, and contact details may change over time, so users should confirm critical information directly with the shelter whenever possible.
